entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes, I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how it works. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Maya Singh, and the order number is... VF789012.
Thank you, Maya. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the ProFit Jersey. Looks like that was delivered about 84 days ago. What seems to be the issue with it?

I finally tried the jersey on for a ride and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight in the shoulders. I was hoping I could do an exchange for a larger size, but I couldn't figure out how. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with this. I'm just checking our policy for you... and good news, this jersey falls within our 90-day return window. So, we can definitely get this processed for you.
Oh, really? Even after all this time? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. Since you'd like a different size, the easiest way is to process a full refund for this jersey, and you can then place a new order for the correct size whenever you're ready. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. Do you still have access to that one?
Yes, I do! Oh, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so easy.

You're very welcome, Maya. Just print that label, and you can drop the package off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride!
